scenario: Sponsored Display conversion reporting contains modeled conversions and an Unallocated dimension row while a targeting-level slice appears to lose purchases.

must: Treat Unallocated modeled conversions as attributed campaign/order conversion evidence that cannot be safely assigned to the requested targeting grain
Do not interpret the targeting-row purchase deficit as zero conversions, lost shopper demand, or target-level waste until allocation coverage is reconciled
Separate campaign-level conversion movement from allocation-to-dimension movement
Downgrade target-level causal claims and traffic-suppression actions to Directional, Hold, or Missing Data when allocation coverage is material
Preserve modeled-versus-direct measurement semantics when comparing periods or sources
must_not: Drop Unallocated rows before computing campaign-level conversion totals
Redistribute Unallocated conversions across targets without supported allocation evidence
Recommend target bid cuts solely from allocated targeting rows when modeled allocation changed

risk: Without an allocation gate, modeled conversions reported on Unallocated rows can make lower-grain rows look artificially weak and trigger false bid cuts or pauses.
